Industry problem and engineering challenge

Students in a large introductory physics class differ in progress and in the topics where they need help.

Engineering constraints

Explanations should use course-relevant sources, and prompts should suit the learner's progress and context.

Technical approach and architecture

Implementation and deliverables

The independent educational application combines course retrieval and problem-solving practice in one learning interface.

Outcome

An introductory physics tutoring application was implemented and made available to students.

  • Course content retrieval
  • Dialogue explanations and adaptive practice

Validation and evidence

The public description covers teaching features and usage. Claims about learning outcomes require a separate evaluation design and data.
